name: Georgia Independent Living Program (GA-RYSE, Chafee services)
org: Georgia Division of Family and Children Services (DFCS)
what_you_do: Help for Georgia foster youth as they grow up. The page lists life skills classes, school money (ETV), housing help, a matched savings account, emergency help and credit report help.
who_can_apply: Youth 14 or older who are in foster care, or were in care for at least 6 months.
pay_detail: Not a job. Cost is not stated on the page.
how_to_apply: Use the Find help near you map on the site to find your Independent Living Specialist (ILS) by region or county. If you have trouble, email askilp@dhs.ga.gov. Your caseworker can also help.
notes: The page lists no phone number. For paid summer jobs for foster youth, see the Georgia C.R.E.W. card. Ask your ILS about the Education and Training Voucher (ETV) for college or training.
